name: Resonant Counter
author: ResonantOS
description: Stateful counter add-on. Proves the workspace-add-on renderer is generic: a second independent local-service add-on shares the host's manifest contract, discovery, sandboxed cross-origin iframe, and postMessage bootstrap — but holds its own loopback origin, its own capability boundary, and its own per-route bearer token.

surfaces.label: Resonant Counter
surfaces.description: Increment, decrement, and reset a counter hosted on this add-on's own loopback origin. State is per-upstream, not global.

grantPresets.label: Local counter
grantPresets.description: Grant the local counter service access to its own loopback endpoint.
